moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 20th week, with new entries from Ariana Grande and Sienna Spiro making waves.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS AT NUMBER 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Is it officially the song of the summer?

angles.name: New Entries & Hot Tracks
angles.copy: New music alert! Ariana Grande bags two new entries in the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10, alongside fresh tracks from Sienna Spiro and Prospa & Cloonee. What's your favourite new hit?

moments.title: UK set for heatwave this week
moments.blurb: The UK is bracing for a significant heatwave, with central and southern England potentially seeing temperatures soar to 33-35°C+ from Wednesday to Friday, following today's pleasant 26°C in London.

angles.name: Heatwave Incoming
angles.copy: Get ready for a scorcher! Temperatures are set to climb to 33-35°C+ across central and southern England this week. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: London Forecast
angles.copy: London, enjoy the 26°C sunshine today, because temperatures are set to hit 35°C by Thursday! How are you planning to beat the heat?

moments.title: Community Shield this Sunday in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, kicks off this Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: First silverware of the season
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City for the Community Shield this Sunday! Who's taking home the first trophy of the season from Cardiff's Principality Stadium?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing! The Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this Sunday as Arsenal take on Manchester City. Get ready for some top-tier football in Wales!

moments.title: EFL season kicks off this weekend
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL season begins this weekend, August 14-16, with Wolverhampton Wanderers hosting Blackburn Rovers on Friday to start the new campaign, and Wrexham in the Championship.

angles.name: EFL is Back
angles.copy: Football is officially BACK! The EFL season kicks off this weekend. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Wrexham in Championship
angles.copy: Wrexham fans, get ready! The Dragons are in the Championship this season, with the EFL kicking off this weekend. What are your hopes for the season?

moments.title: Premier League season starts August 22nd
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to kick off on Saturday, August 22nd, marking a slightly later start due to the expanded World Cup.

angles.name: Premier League Returns
angles.copy: Less than two weeks to go! The Premier League season kicks off on August 22nd. Who are you tipping for the title this year?

angles.name: Countdown to Kickoff
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns on August 22nd. What match are you most looking forward to in the opening weekend?

moments.title: Ben Gibbard turns 50
moments.blurb: Today, August 11th, marks the 50th birthday of Ben Gibbard, the influential frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and co-founder of The Postal Service.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Half-Century
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to indie legend Ben Gibbard! From Death Cab for Cutie to The Postal Service, what's your favourite track from the man himself?

angles.name: Celebrating a Songwriter
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 50th Birthday to Ben Gibbard! His emotive lyrics have soundtracked so many moments. Which Death Cab or Postal Service song means the most to you?

moments.title: Joe Jackson celebrates 71st birthday
moments.blurb: The acclaimed English singer-songwriter and musician, Joe Jackson, turns 71 today, August 11th.

angles.name: Musical Maverick
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the incredible Joe Jackson! From 'Is She Really Going Out With Him?' to 'Steppin' Out', his music spans decades. What's your favourite Joe Jackson tune?

moments.title: Alyson Stoner turns 33
moments.blurb: American actor, singer, and dancer Alyson Stoner, known for roles in 'Step Up' and 'Phineas and Ferb', celebrates their 33rd birthday today, August 11th.

angles.name: Multi-talented star
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the multi-talented Alyson Stoner! From dancing in music videos to voicing Isabella in Phineas and Ferb, they've done it all. What's your favourite Alyson Stoner moment?

moments.title: Steve Martin celebrates 81st birthday
moments.blurb: The legendary actor, comedian, and musician Steve Martin turns 81 on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Comedy & Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday this Friday to the incomparable Steve Martin! A true legend of comedy and a talented musician. What's your favourite Steve Martin movie or musical performance?

moments.title: Aphex Twin turns 55
moments.blurb: Influential electronic musician Richard David James, better known as Aphex Twin, celebrates his 55th birthday on Tuesday, August 18th.

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to the groundbreaking Aphex Twin this Tuesday! A true pioneer of electronic music. What's your favourite track from the master?

moments.title: MC Eric (Technotronic) turns 58

angles.name: Technotronic Icon
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to Cardiff's own MC Eric of Technotronic this Tuesday! Get ready to 'Pump Up The Jam' in celebration!

angles.name: Welsh Dance Legend
angles.copy: A big Welsh Hapus Pen-blwydd to MC Eric! The Technotronic star turns 58 on Tuesday. What's your favourite 90s dance anthem?

moments.title: Angélique Kidjo to receive Walk of Fame star
moments.blurb: Beninese singer Angélique Kidjo will make history on Tuesday, August 18th, as she becomes the first Black African musician to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

angles.name: Historic Honour
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Angélique Kidjo! She receives a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame this Tuesday, making history as the first Black African musician to be honoured. A true icon!

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) turns 55

angles.name: Prodigy's Visionary
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday this Friday to Liam Howlett of The Prodigy! The electronic music world wouldn't be the same without him. What's your ultimate Prodigy track?

moments.title: Serj Tankian (System Of A Down) turns 59
moments.blurb: System Of A Down frontman Serj Tankian celebrates his 59th birthday on Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: SOAD Legend
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the iconic Serj Tankian of System Of A Down this Friday! His voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite SOAD anthem?

moments.title: Kelis celebrates 47th birthday
moments.blurb: R&B and soul singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', turns 47 on Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to the incredible Kelis this Friday! From 'Milkshake' to 'Trick Me', her tracks always bring the heat. What's your go-to Kelis song?

moments.title: Kim Sledge (Sister Sledge) turns 69
moments.blurb: Kim Sledge, a member of the iconic disco and R&B group Sister Sledge, celebrates her 69th birthday on Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: Disco Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to Kim Sledge of Sister Sledge this Friday! Get ready to 'We Are Family' in celebration of this disco queen!

moments.title: Kacey Musgraves turns 38
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country music star Kacey Musgraves celebrates her 38th birthday on Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: Country Star
angles.copy: Happy 38th Birthday to the brilliant Kacey Musgraves this Friday! Her unique sound has won hearts worldwide. What's your favourite Kacey track?

angles.name: Rock Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 41st Birthday to Jake Pitts of Black Veil Brides this Friday! Send some love to the guitar hero!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival kicks off next week
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, a celebration of jazz and UK club culture, takes place August 20-23 in Dorset, but tickets are now sold out.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is just around the corner, starting next Thursday! Celebrating the best of jazz and UK club culture. Who's heading to Dorset?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is officially SOLD OUT! Get ready for four days of incredible music and culture in Dorset, starting August 20th. For those with tickets, get excited!

moments.title: Heather On The Hill festival in Edinburgh
moments.blurb: A new family festival, Heather On The Hill, takes place on Saturday, August 22nd, in Edinburgh, featuring Cian Ducrot, Ella Henderson, Skerryvore, and more.

angles.name: Scottish Festival Fun
angles.copy: Edinburgh, get ready for Heather On The Hill next Saturday! Cian Ducrot, Ella Henderson and more are set to perform at this new family festival. Who's coming?

moments.title: Summer holidays winding down for some
moments.blurb: While summer holidays continue for most of England and Wales until late August, schools in Scotland typically finish their break around mid-August, with some returning as early as today.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: For many in Scotland, it's back to school today or this week! How was your summer holiday? Share your favourite memories!

angles.name: End of Summer Vibes
angles.copy: The end of summer holidays is in sight for some, but many in England and Wales still have weeks of fun left! What's top of your summer bucket list before September?

moments.title: Ted Lasso Season 4 airing weekly on Apple TV
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated fourth season of 'Ted Lasso' premiered on Apple TV on August 5th, with new episodes dropping weekly until the finale on October 7th.

angles.name: Believe in Ted Lasso
angles.copy: 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 is here and streaming weekly on Apple TV! Who's catching up on the latest from Richmond AFC? Believe!

angles.name: Weekly TV Fix
angles.copy: Your weekly dose of feel-good TV is here! New episodes of 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 are dropping every week on Apple TV. What's been your favourite moment so far?
